title: Man Inside Vintage Car Window, 1941 B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A close-up black-and-white snapshot focusing on the side door and window of a 1930s-1940s automobile. In the dark interior, the profile of a man sitting inside the vehicle is visible through the vent and main window glass. Handwritten on the reverse is the date May 14, 1941, placing this photograph in the months leading up to the United States' entry into World War II.
